question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I was completely __mesmerised __by the performance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Fascinated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mesmerised"** means to hold the attention of someone to the exclusion of all else or so as to transfix them. (मंत्रमुग्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **The magician's performance left the audience mesmerised.
 
 
 
• **"Fascinated" **refers to being intensely interested in or attracted by someone or something. (मोहित)
 
 
• **Example: **She was fascinated by the intricate details of the painting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Fascinated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Irritated **(चिढ़): Feeling annoyed or slightly angry.

 
 
• **Example:** She was irritated by the constant noise outside her window.
 
 
 
• **Annoyed **(परेशान): Slightly angry; irritated.
 
 
• **Example: **He was annoyed by the delay in the delivery of his package.
 
 
 
• **Bored** (उबाऊ): Feeling weary and impatient because one is unoccupied or lacks interest in one's current activity.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that the students appeared bored.
